# Example dataset: pasilla

Gene-level read counts from Brooks *et al.* (2011), *Conservation of an RNA
regulatory map between Drosophila and mammals*, Genome Research 21:193-202
(doi:10.1101/gr.108662.110): RNAi knock-down of *pasilla* in Drosophila S2-DRSC
cells, 3 treated vs 4 untreated samples, sequenced single-read or paired-end.

Source: Bioconductor data package
[`pasilla`](https://bioconductor.org/packages/pasilla/) (LGPL),
file `inst/extdata/pasilla_gene_counts.tsv`. The design file was built from
`pasilla_sample_annotation.csv` (columns `condition` and `type`).

The knocked-down gene *pasilla* is `FBgn0261552`.
